purge_squid_conf_path.description: Path to the squid.conf file used to discover cache directories.

purge_host.description: Host and port of the Squid cache to connect to.

purge_action_bits.description: Action bits: 0 (print only), 1 (send PURGE), 2 (unlink weird files).

purge_sequential_mode.description: If true, disables parallel execution (-n flag) to reduce system load.

purge_rescue_dir.description: Directory to copy rescued cache objects to. If null, copy-out mode is disabled.

purge_keep_headers.description: If true and rescue mode is active, keeps HTTP headers in rescued files.

purge_expressions.description: List of regular expressions to search for/purge. Use single-item lists for -E or multiple for repeated -E flags.

purge_expression_file.description: Path to a file containing regular expressions. If null, uses inline expressions or none.
